description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the Request class in the OrangeHRM Core API module. It verifies that the Request object correctly initializes and retrieves query parameters, body parameters, and attributes from the HTTP request simulation.

classes.name: RequestTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the Request class behaviors and parameter retrieval.

methods.name: testRequest
methods.description: Test method that creates various HttpRequest instances and validates that the Request class properly encapsulates and retrieves query, body, and attribute parameters.
